slice: P4 selected AC1018 BLOCK_RECORD to INSERT source relation
scope: Private, on-demand source-only relation for a selected AC1018 BLOCK_RECORD profile with one BLKREFS group-331 and a selected authenticated INSERT/ATTRIB/SEQEND compound, all bound to the same accepted import and context.

contract.operation: Match every selected BLOCK_RECORD group to the whole-read decoded scalar/lexeme record and ordinal spans, including ignored comments and ASCII spellings where captured; bind its self, TABLE owner, name and selected 331 to the separately source-bound compound INSERT and original block name. Return source identity and name/reference spans only.
contract.admission: Authenticate whole, identity, structural and compound owners, import/generation/container and codec context; build a bounded identity index and precharge source/delivery counts, field and string comparisons. Quota failure returns no relation and leaves source state intact.
contract.unqualified: Name uniqueness and target resolution, complete owner/extension/APPID/LAYER graph, regenerated output, native semantics, arbitrary source profiles and support claims.

validation.focusedControls: Generated ASCII and binary input: paired callback 331 spoof, original/whole owner and context substitutions, omitted/duplicate/mutated observer callbacks, exact and one-below work/bytes budgets and corrected retries; ignored comments before/within/after selected body, same-data refusal. The many-source/no-delivery low-quota control shows refusal and restored retry; it does not isolate scan ordering from the fixed quota charge. Early count check and both scan precharges were independently code reviewed.
validation.inventory: Source inventory check passed 625 tracked files.

independentSource.result: Selected original 6F2 name MyBlock and its 331 value 704 match the 704 INSERT compound source.

localSpoof.derivation: Local test copy changes only the selected BLKREFS 331 from 704 to 703; callbacks rewrite both retained raw and typed views back to 704.
localSpoof.result: The earlier raw/typed pairing and selected profile accept the coordinated spoof, but the whole-source body comparison refuses the relation.

limitations: The whole-read observer is a decoded scalar and available value-spelling census, not a byte-exact file image.
The 331 relation is source-only: it neither proves target-name uniqueness nor resolves an INSERT target, whole graph, XDICTIONARY, APPID/LAYER or export.
ACadSharp sample producer/native authoring semantics and native application behavior are not independently certified. No drawing fixture is committed.
